articleTitle: MCG-based device for transmission line charging
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: At present, MCGs are the most powerful energy sources. Existing level of high technology as well as numerical simulation methods allow one to create MCGs with characteristics varying over a wide range of values, which gives new prospects for creation of compact MCGs for different pulsed power applications. By estimate, we select the circuit consisting of MCG, electroexplosive opening switch, pulse transformer and forming line (FL) with water insulation. MCG winding is connected in series with EEOS and primary winding of the transformer which is used as an intermediate inductive storage. By the end of MCG operation the current through the primary winding of the transformer is maximum. EEOS characteristics are properly chosen to set up wire explosion by this instance and to break the circuit of primary winding of the transformer. In result, in the secondary winding a high emf is induced, which allows one to charge the FL up to the voltage 450-500 kV during a short time period (approximately 200 ns).

articleTitle: Adaptive antenna for control stations of radionavigation satellite systems
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Ways of construction and technical realisation of the adaptive antenna for control stations of radionavigation satellite systems are constructed on the basis of multichannel space processing of digital signals and microwaves and microelectronic technologies.

articleTitle: TEM cell electromagnetic field simulation
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The main advantage of the developed software is the possibility to solve the electromagnetic field problem in the case of complicated shapes of shield and septums of TEM cell. It allows design of new and existing TEM cells and improves the uniformity of electromagnetic field and increases operating frequency range (by increasing cutoff, frequency of higher order modes and suppression of unwanted resonance). The software also allows one to investigate the influence of additional elements in the TEM cell design (for example, a lateral waveguide) on parameters and characteristics of TEM cell.

articleTitle: Optimal dielectric lens antennas with one or two homogeneous spherical layers
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: We present the results of finding the extreme of accessible parameters of some lens antennas. Antennas were constructed on the base of the elementary structures-of a homogeneous one- or two-layer dielectric full-sphere with an optimum level of an exciting electromagnetic field on a rim. The computational and experimental results are given for some versions of real antennas.

articleTitle: Reproduction of spectrum envelope of microwave wideband noise and detection a narrowband signal in it
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A method of adequate visual microwave wide-band intense noise envelope reproduction in wide frequency range (several octaves), power parameters measurement and detection of a narrow-band signal with unknown frequency and power against a background of noise is presented. It is based on application of nonheterodyne gyromagnetic converter, operating in two regimes: resonance detection and cross-multiplication. Operation of the two-channel measurer of spectrum power density combining the mentioned functions is discussed.

articleTitle: Personal computer functional disorders under effect of ultra-short duration electromagnetic pulses
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Results of comparative experimental study for the personal computer functional disorders under an effect of the ultra-short pulse (USP) duration EMP with various spectral characteristics are discussed. The radiation field/power spectral density of the USP source are offered as basic criteria for practical applications in the field of electromagnetic compatibility and survivability (EMC/EMS).

articleTitle: Ship detection by its shadow on the sea surface
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: We present the results of our investigations, both theoretical and experimental, of a possible mechanism of IMPATT diode failures. The mechanism is related to local nonuniformities of the temperature distribution over the active area.

articleTitle: Waveguide probe structure on microwave
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Using a passive GaAs matching network in the fabrication of broadband microwave power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Modeling with resonant tunneling structure simulator RTS-NANODEV
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A simulator for resonant tunneling devices RTS-NANODEV is described. It consists of three units. articleTitle: Radiating system based on insulated image waveguide
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Surface magnetism of silicon [111](7/spl times/7) and [001](2/spl times/1) surfaces: quantum-chemical approach
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Possible forms of the field distribution at the radiator for wireless power transmission
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

Possible methods of analysis of the above-mentioned antennae are examined in this paper.

articleTitle: Fiber optical frequency domain reflectometer
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: One of the main ways to develop nondestructive testing devices for fiber communication systems is to use optical reflectometry in the frequency domain (OFDR) and the LFM-technique. There are some problems in OFDR-systems which are determined by the complexity degree of modulation type realization, low energy characteristics of frequency modulators and large scattering losses on reflectometer units in general. In the present paper we consider some common and special solutions for these problems. Especially a new LFM-technique based on dual-frequency laser radiation, which can help us to develop a compact reflectometer, is presented. Basic consideration of single frequency radiation transformation into two frequency radiation is given. The elements of the LFM technique for the reflectometer are given. We determined the output radiation parameters and their connection with the degree of internal and external disturbances and coordinates along the axis of the fiber, and calculated the accuracy characteristics of system. We showed that two frequency output radiation carried more information and could help us to obtain results close to that of the two-mode reflectometer. The experimental set-up of a structural testing system and the first practical results are given.

articleTitle: Simulation of the single-electron transistors based on different materials
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The theoretical investigation of the constructive-technological and electrophysical parameters influencing the single-electron transistor characteristics (temperature of operation, frequency limit, current-voltage characteristic) is carried out. The single-electron device simulator SET-NANODEV was used for the investigations. The single-electron transistors based on different metals were considered. Behavior of the single-electron transistor characteristics depending on material and construction parameters was determined.

articleTitle: The mean temperature of semiconductor bodies measurement using radiometric method
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The basic problems of the mean temperature values of semiconductor bodies measurement by radiometric methods are studied. The objectives are to minimize the deviation of determined data from the mean temperature value. With that aim a number of approaches are presented. For elementary cases the mean temperature value is estimated by one-fold measurement. Optimization problem is to find the frequency band as well as antenna properties which minimize the deviation of determined value from the object mean temperature. Reconstruction procedures are based on utilization of a number of measured data. Measurements are carried out under different conditions distinguished by frequency band or some antenna parameters. The mean temperature value is found from the temperature distribution reconstructed from measured data. The weighted summing method also is based on a number of measured data utilizations. The estimated value of the object mean temperature is calculated by weighted summing of measured data. In accordance with the proposed approach weights are determined as real values minimized by the deviation of weighted sum from the mean temperature value. For presented approaches the principal problems are formulated, calculation procedures are discussed and a number of numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: The pattern forming system of the radiotelescope BSA FIAN
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The radiotelescope BSA FIAN, constructed in 1974 in Pushchino Radio Astronomy of Astrospace centre of Physical institute of Russian Academy of Science (PRAO ASC LPI), is one of the most sensitive tools in the meter wave range. In 1998 the radiotelescope was reconstructed to be interference free, working in range 109-113 MHz. The dipoles, feed lines and pattern forming system were changed. The matrix for forming the 16 beam pattern is presented. This matrix is constructed from coaxial hybrid rings.

articleTitle: Finite-size planar dielectric structures as superposition of quasi-periodical refractive indexes
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: On the problem of forming fields synthesis of SHF devices with partial screening by cathode from magnetic field
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Analogue technologies of transient period for infotelecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Peculiarities of transient period for infotelecommunication systems in Tatatrstan Republic are considered. Accounting for economic efficiency and state-of-the art in real telecommunication devices a conclusion about necessity of analogue technologies use is made. Conversion of one frequency oscillation into two frequency and two band oscillations is described as the basic method for development of analogue devices and techniques used in infotelecommunication systems. Using two frequency oscillation allows us to create frequency domain LFM-reflectometer with high accuracy of NDE structural monitoring and location of unauthorized access. Use of two band oscillations allows us to create communication lines with reduction of band pass and hence increase of information capacity. Parameters of conversion and their effect on output spectrum composition are discussed. The given method allows us to get spectrum characteristics with high stability of amplitudes and frequencies. That is very important for measuring and for communication systems.

articleTitle: MCG with EEOS application to forming line power supply
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Inductive storage of energy (IS) with EEOS allows one to charge forming line during about 10/sup -7/ sec therefore providing high electrical strength of insulation as well as small size and weight. In the paper, by means of numerical simulation and physical modeling three schemes of device with primary source energy amplifier-explosive magnetic generator (EMG) are analyzed. The schemes are distinguished by the charging models: a) EMG+dynamic transformer+IS+EEOS, b) EMG+transformer IS(TIS)+EEOS and c) EMG+EEOS+TIS. The basic parameter defining efficiency of the device operation is (/spl radic/L/sub IS/C/sub FL/)//spl tau/ which is the characteristic time of (IS-FL) circuit to time constant of EEOS ratio. The last is practically a single-valued function of effective (by EEOS current action integral) EMG current rise-time. Scheme a) in comparison with scheme c) provides the minimum rise-time of voltage across FL as a capacitor, but boosts it in efficiency of energy transfer, overall dimensions (wire case sizes are bigger than FL ones and have the maximum achievable voltage peak). Scheme b) is an intermediate one by its characteristics. The fulfilled analysis of the given schemes in comparison with the same schemes with a bank of capacitors as a power source, showed a significant advantage of EMG used in a wide range of FL capacitance (up to subnanofarads) at FL energy content of more than 10/sup 2/ J.

publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Concept of infotelecommunication nets on the basis of open assortment of infotelecommunication services and strategy of its development are formulated. Models of nets and devices which allow one to evaluate its efficiency, are considered.

articleTitle: Research results of the radio-frequency characteristics of microwave devices
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: In this paper the research results of the radio-frequency characteristics of microwave devices are presented. The calculations were conducted with the application of a nonlinear physical-based model of a GaAs field-effect transistor with a Schottky barrier (MESFET). The comparative characteristics for the simulation analysis were extracted from measured S-parameters (Materka model), and the nonlinear physical model based on the analysis of the parameters of the semiconductor structure and the geometrical dimensions of the electrodes of the transistor, is deduced. Linear (gain, input/output VSWR) and nonlinear (output power, intermodulation distortion) parameters of a power amplifier are surveyed. The good coincidence of calculated and measured parameters is shown.

articleTitle: Complex decision of microwave radar antenna switch speed problem
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Microwave antenna switches are used usually for transmit-receive decoupling, artificial load-antenna decoupling, receiver-receiver decoupling and transmitter-transmitter decoupling. The design of microwave antenna switches meets with contradictory demands. One of them is the contradiction between channel switch speed and high microwave switching power. At the same time there are limits on bandwidth, main power supply, cost, weight and size. At the present time the PIN-diode is the most convenient device for average power antenna switch design. Compared with the FET transistor, the PIN-diode is low cost, offers low parasitic capacitance and spurious inductance, and higher reverse-bias breakdown voltage. However, the PIN-diode has lower high-speed switching and requires more control current. In order to overcome the contradictory demands, a few design approaches are proposed.

abstract: It was established that the coupling coefficient of two neighbouring microstrip resonators (separated by a narrow clearance) could be successfully controlled by the openings in the resonator electrodes. Based on these resonators, a new compact microstrip filter with a narrow bandpass (less than 1%) were realized.

publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: An addition to the influence of harmonic loads on MESFET amplifiers output power
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present results of a 2 GHz amplifier's output power calculations, up to phase of load reflection coefficient at 4 GHz and 6 GHz frequency. articleTitle: Phase characteristics of stub PIN-attenuators
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Analysis results of microstrip stub PIN-attenuator characteristics are presented. articleTitle: Computer software for training of GMDSS operators
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The last stage of putting into operation of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) was completed in February 1999. In this connection it is necessary to train specialists in the field of GMDSS communication. The existing software for training of the GMDSS operators is designed for foreign equipment using the English language. This paper's goal is to develop and create a new software for the training of GMDSS operators using the Russian language. The initial design results and projects of this computer software for operator training are presented.

articleTitle: Reflection of a Gaussian beam from a ferrite slab
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Experimental research of temperature errors in acousto-optic frequency moment counter
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of experimental measurement of errors in an acousto-optic (AO) frequency counter are presented. This type of error is caused by temperature effect in AO deflectors (Bragg cells), which are the main elements of AO frequency counter. In the case, when input power is large, some characteristics of AO deflectors change. This causes the common mistake of AO frequency counters. AO deflectors are made of tellurium dioxide (TeO/sub 2/) and lead molybdenum tetra oxide (PbMoO/sub 4/) were tested. The construction temperature conductivity of AO deflectors was different. It is proved, that in the case AO frequency counter works with wide dynamic range of input radio signal's power, this type of error may be equal to some percents.

articleTitle: Microwave method application to liquid level measurement
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Microwave techniques and device for the measurement of liquid levels using phased radar methods is presented. That method gives an increase in level measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: The metal-dielectric strip waveguide analysis
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The metal-dielectric strip waveguide (MDSW) is widely used in the short-wave part of the millimetric and submillimetric range of wavelengths. It possesses a constructive simplicity, polarizing stability and rather small losses. A theoretical analysis is presented. The amplitude distributions of any field composition were found with the registration of losses in the dielectric. The dispersion equations for MDSW have also been determined.

articleTitle: One-interval radio-relay server of 14.4-15.35 GHz range produced using the elements of satellite technology
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The preliminary results of development of one-interval radio-relay line distinguished by the low cost and good electromagnetic compatibility with other radio electronic devices, are given.

articleTitle: High-accuracy microwave gauge
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Radar distance measurer (gauge) works in 8-mm band and allows highly accurate measuring of small distances. The gauge emits quasi-continuous frequency-modulated signal. Processing includes fast Fourier transform and special algorithms for raising accuracy of measurement. Principles of construction, technical characteristics and design features are given. The gauge can be used for fluid level measurement in reservoirs, storage and shifts in hydro-technical dams.

articleTitle: Superheterodyne ESR-spectrometer
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A superheterodyne ESR spectrometer for automatic measurements has been designed. Superheterodyne realisation of the super-high-frequency section, computer control and data processing allow one to study signals of absorption and dispersion without frequency modulation.

articleTitle: Conditions of achievement of maximum flat drain current and drain voltage waveforms in the microwave F-class power amplifier on GaAs MESFET
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Shows that the greatest efficiency of the microwave power amplifier is reached when harmonics with identical numbers do not present a spectra of voltage and current of the active device (bipolar or the field-effect transistor) output simultaneously. It is noted, that the least power dissipation in the transistor can be achieved at the maximum flat current and voltage waveforms at its output. Since current has no odd harmonics and voltage has no even harmonics (or vice-versa), the maximum flat voltage and current are the necessary conditions for achievement of maximum efficiency of the amplifier. The requirements for obtaining the maximum flat current and voltage waveforms imposed on impedances of input and output matching circuits of microwave power amplifier on the GaAs MESFET are given.

articleTitle: The magnetron periodical system with complex shape resonators
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The comparative analysis is performed by a numerical method for the unequal resonator periodical magnetron systems formed by resonators of the following types: "sector", "sector-sector", "slot-sector" and of combinations: "sector-sector"-"sector", "slot-sector"-"sector". As shown, the periodical systems formed by more complex shape resonators make it possible to decrease the anode voltage and increase the heat resistance of the system.

articleTitle: Meter for measuring the nondestructive quality control of paint coatings and multilayer nonconductive composite material adhesion in 5 mm wave band
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The paper presents the results of design, manufacture and research into the meter for measuring the nondestructive quality control of paint coating adhesion and multilayer composite material adhesive strength. The meter optimisation is based on dimensional and weighting parameters and cost.

articleTitle: Sensitivity increasing of microwave converters based on strip metal-dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: An analysis of the dependence of power flow density in the center and at the edges of the media interface of the strip metal-dielectric waveguide on its design parameters, has been conducted. The expressions which connect the amplitudes of the cross-sectional field components defining the microwave converters sensitivity, with parameters of the transmission line, have been presented. It has been shown that the change of width of the dielectric microstrip makes it possible to achieve an increase in microwave converter sensitivity.

articleTitle: Technique for acoustic impedance calculation of coupling layers in acoustooptic device
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A technique for engineering calculation of acoustic impedance frequency dependence of multilayered structure is offered and generalized when in its separate elements a springy wave reduction occurs. An algorithm and program for input impedance calculation have been realized. Numerical results calculated for ZnO-Al-Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ structure are presented.

articleTitle: Dipole's matching for several narrow bands
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The problem of multi-frequency dipole's matching is discussed. A possibility and reasons for this problem's solution by a multiconductor-line balun is shown. The balun contains a three-conductor transmission line and additional conductors. The analysis method for such structures is described and experimental results are given.

articleTitle: The measurement of dielectric parameters of liquids in microwave range
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The possibility of using the method applied to investigate the near-field zone by passive antenna is considered. The vibrating string probe is used. To check the method the complex permittivity of kerosene is used.

articleTitle: Microwave wattmeter of rotating type with absorbing sensitive element
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of the research of stepping motor microwave wattmeters with absorbing sensitive element are given.

articleTitle: The nonlinear analytical theory of the auto-resonant peniotron operating in the oscillator and amplifier regimes
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The nonlinear analytical self-consistent theory is presented for the auto-resonance peniotron with a multiply connected electrodynamical system in the generation and amplification regimes on high cyclotron frequency harmonics. These devices, as shown, have prospects as effective millimeter and submillimeter wave sources operating without superconducting magnets.

articleTitle: Transformation problems in crossed-field devices
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Stochastic oscillations were observed in microwave electron devices. The excess noise and azimuthal space charge oscillations in crossed-field dynamical systems were studied at the preoscillation stage. It was found that the cause of nonregular oscillations in magnetrons are random jumping against different oscillation modes or oscillation interruptions but not noise arising. To simplify such nonlinear dynamical systems we proposed to investigate simple magnetron diode behavior.

articleTitle: Capacitance-voltage profiling of GaAs metal-semiconductor field-effect transistors and geometrical interelectrode capacitance
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: It is shown that the geometrical interelectrode capacitance of a GaAs metal-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MESFET) must be allowed for when determining the channel doping profile from capacitance-voltage measurements. A simple method of determining this interelectrode capacitance as the constant the measured high-frequency capacitance-voltage characteristic tends to is proposed.

articleTitle: Investigation of local nonlinear microwave response of ceramic HTS [YBaCuO]
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of measurements of nonlinear microwave response of ceramic high-T/sub c/ superconductor are presented. A new technique of local investigation of nonlinearity was worked out. The temperature and dc magnetic field dependencies of the third harmonic power were used for the analysis of origin of nonlinearity in HTS.

articleTitle: Continuous education system for electromagnetic ecology
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of continuous electromagnetic-ecology education concept realisation are presented. The solutions contain an education system for elementary, secondary and higher school, higher education and professional training.

articleTitle: Measuring converter of millimeter wave band
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The methods of decreasing of an error of measurement of modulus and phase of reflection coefficient, which is caused by nonlinearity of microwave detector characteristic, are considered.

articleTitle: Using microwaves for modeling of optical processes
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The microwave device for modelling of optical processes was performed. The results of light scattering, absorption and reflection by the layers of dielectric cubic particles are presented.

articleTitle: Field distribution analysis in the aperture of a two-mirror antenna with a biased focal axes
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of a theoretical study of the field distribution in the aperture of a two-mirror antenna with biased focal axes are presented.

articleTitle: The problem of synthesis of magnetic periodic systems by R-grid method using a computer
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The problems of synthesis of magnetic periodic systems of microwave devices with the help of two R-grids using a computer are considered. The synthesis of magnetic periodic systems is carried out by taking account of the characteristics of permanent magnets which create the required distribution of a magnetic field on the axis.

articleTitle: The influence of magnetic relaxation on the spectra of signals propagating in film ferrite transmission line
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The influence of magnetic relaxation of magnetic layer on the spectra of signals propagating in film ferrite transmission line is considered. The magnetic relaxation changes spectra (form) of signals propagating in ferrite transmission line. The high-frequency part of the spectrum is depressed more than the low-frequence part. The value of relaxation time has a satisfactory coincidence with that defined for the ferromagnetic resonance.

articleTitle: Kernel regularization method for integral equations of planar structures
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A kernel regularization method for surface immittance integral equations has been introduced. The results of the modeling of microstrip resonators using the finite element method for rectangular and nonrectangular surfaces are presented.

articleTitle: Powerful pulse semiconductor transmitters at MM wave range
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of designing and producing high pulse power IMPATT MM-wave transmitters are presented.

articleTitle: Algorithm for processing of radar signals when measuring undividing projectile movement parameters on the initial stage of a shot
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The algorithm for processing of radar signals obtained when measuring undividing projectiles (demolition and cumulative projectiles) movement parameters on the initial stage of a shot is described.

articleTitle: Antenna field statistics caused by the influence of sea roughness
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The mathematic model of statistical evaluation of the radiation characteristics of a one dimensional aperture is given. The results of the radiation intensity calculation in the main direction are given.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of characteristics of DRG with local inhomogeneity of magnetostatic field focusing
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Obtains and analyses amplitude and radius of the spot of local magnetostatic field inhomogeneity (LMI), created by a cylindrical ferromagnetic stick within the space of interaction of the diffractional radiation generator (DRG). A possibility to use these parameters for theoretical research of starting, power and other DRG characteristics is shown.

articleTitle: Planar traveling-wave amplifier of mm-wave band with different velocities of electron streams
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Results of the electron-wave interaction in nonresonant travelling-wave-tube amplifier with few electron beams is discussed. Beams have different initial velocities. Two cases of small and strong magnetic field are considered.

articleTitle: New absorbing material gks and results of an experimental estimation of absorbing properties on microwave range
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Electroconductivity and structural-phase changes of anodic aluminum oxide implanted by titanium and molybdenum
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Investigation results of electroconductivity and structural-phase changes in anodic aluminium oxide implanted by titanium and molybdenum ions are presented. Decrease of oxide resistance to the tens of Ohm's, transformation of amorphous state to the crystalline state and vice versa, and morphology changes of anodic aluminium oxide were found.

articleTitle: Development of a unified satellite system of information transfer of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The perspective and development of a unified satellite system of information transfer for the Ukraine are presented. The features of a hybrid network of information transfer and the space segment are disclosed.

articleTitle: Microwave transducer for meters of antenna-feeder tracts parameters
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Microwave transducer for meters of antenna-feeder tracts parameters with application of designed software in order to control the measurement process is represented.

articleTitle: Definition of location of the radio source. Model investigation
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of modeling of the process of definition of the location of radio sources using the three-position radio system, are presented. This software allows us to select a method of definition of the location and topology of the system for the simulation of measurement of parameters with the information about location of a radio source and the estimation of potential inaccuracy of the method. The results of researches can be used for design of radio systems for definition of location of the radio source.

articleTitle: Nonlinear microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Microstrip antenna elements with nonlinear semiconductor diodes or transistors are considered The results of theoretical calculations and experimental investigations are presented. Nonlinear microstrip antennas may be used in phased array in cm- and mm-wavelength.

articleTitle: The investigation of the optimized variants for TWT with cathode modulation
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The mathematical model and software has been developed to find and to analyze the optimized parameters of TWTCM taking account of the higher harmonic components of the irregular slowing system.

articleTitle: E/sub 01/-wave scattering on the boundary of semitransparent dielectrics in circular waveguide
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The problem of E/sub 01/-wave scattering on an obstacle in the shape of a plane spiral with substrate and dielectric media in a circular waveguide has been solved.

articleTitle: The creation of network of navigation maintenance monitoring stations in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The development aspects of a national network of monitoring stations using the NAVSTAR (USA) and GLONASS (RF) systems and, in the long term, GNSS are given on the basis of the projects ESA, EGNOS and GALILEO.

articleTitle: Measurement method of antenna polarization characteristics
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The method of polarisation characteristics measurement is presented for arbitrary antennas. The measurement equipment scheme is shown.

articleTitle: Parameters definition of polar diagram strength of the electromagnetic field of SHF-device magnetic systems
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Performs the analysis of dipole component distribution of external magnetic field strength. Uses a body of mathematics of multifield representation of magnetic field to increase measurement accuracy of polar diagram. This is proposed an effective magnetometric method to define polar diagram parameters.

articleTitle: Decreased side lobes linear antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: By computer modelling an analysis of the main characteristics of linear antennas, such as its pattern main lobe width, directivity coefficient, side lobe level and scattering coefficient, for excluding or uni-phase excitation of radiator pair in the array, has been carried out. An optimal location of such radiators was determined, which provides minimum for the first side lobe.

articleTitle: Electron bunching in relativistic klystrons
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The analytical expressions for amplitudes of convection current harmonics with relativistic effects are presented. Solution of this problem is conducted on the basis of the electron stream's one-dimensional model. Space charge force effect is taken into account by introducing equivalent plasma frequency.

articleTitle: Low orbital satellite system "Orbcomm" for urgent message transmission and data collection
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The paper gives brief characteristics of the global low orbital satellite communication system (Orbcomm), its structure, parameters and the kind of service to be expected.

articleTitle: The up-converter with digital control for satellite communication stations
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of designing of an up-converter for C-band satcom stations are presented. There are two transformations of frequency from 70/spl plusmn/20 MHz to 5725-6225 MHz in the converter. It includes two synthesizers, two mixers, amplifiers, filters and the controller for control and telemetry translation.

articleTitle: The compensating modulating spectroanalyser
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of design of a compensating modulating spectroanalyser of noise and determined signals for diagnostic biological objects are submitted. For this purpose the range of research frequencies is (0.5...80) GHz with a millimetre range chosen.

articleTitle: Propagation of the plane electromagnetic wave through nonuniform dielectric layer of finite thickness
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The asymptotic solution of the problem of the plane electromagnetic wave propagation through dielectric layer of finite thickness with arbitrary small variation of the complex dielectric permittivity along the direction of the electromagnetic wave propagation was presented.

articleTitle: Resonant field emission from cathodes with diamond like coating
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The mathematical model of field emission from Si cathodes with ultrathin (diamond like) coating (DLC) was created. The emission current dependences from cathode parameters and a perspective of cathodes with DLC use for submillimeter range electromagnetic waves generation and amplification are studied.

articleTitle: Dynamic allocation of resource of VSAT network by ABCS technology
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The principle of dynamic allocation of the satellite communications network traffic capacity by ABCS technology (Advanced Business Communication via Satellite), constructed by frame relay technology is discussed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic polaritons in double two-dimensional electron systems
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: In the paper nonradiation electromagnetic polaritons (surface and bulk) in semiconductor structures, consisting of two heterojunctions, GaAs/AlGaAs, under the conditions of integer quantum Hall effect (IQHE), have been investigated. Their dispersion, polarization and energy characteristics have been determined, taking into account the dissipation in two-dimensional systems.

articleTitle: Electrodynamics of coupled cavities chain, blown by e-beam
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The electrodynamics of the inductively coupled cavities blown round by a tubular electron beam and filled with plasma have been theoretically investigated. The dispersion equation is derived. The interaction of the electron beam with a structure of this type is considered. The amplification factor is obtained and efficiency estimation is made.

articleTitle: Designing of LNA with protection from high level input power
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: In designing LNA it is necessary to conduct optimisation of scheme and topology of amplifier, choice of active element, protection, as well as reliability and price. Possible power level at the input of FET or HEMT LNA is chosen. Graphs correspond to average technological variant of GaAs FET or HEMT. Possible diffuse impulse power in GaAs transistor is discussed with respect to constant power.

articleTitle: Perspectives of extreme HF-therapy in medicine
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: EHF-therapy has showed positive results in maniac depressive psychoses (a total coming out of a depressive condition has been observed), in cardiology it helped in stenocardia (hypocoagulant changes of haemostasis system have been obtained), in stomatology it helped in treatment of paradontitis (it reduced inflammation symptoms by means of increase of blood vessel tonus, normalization of local blood circulation etc.), in oncology it helped in immunosuppressive conditions (immune system stimulation), in therapy it helped in stomach and duodenal ulcers (acceleration of ulcer defects regeneration), in surgery it helped in osseous pathologies of trauma (improvement of general condition and decrease of edemas), in ophthalmology it helped in cornea trauma, eyelid skin inflammations (accelerated recovery). In the results of experimental tests in veterinary medicine, it has been revealed that EHF-therapy favorably influences the conduction of wound processes and inflammation reactions.

articleTitle: The changing of electrophoretic mobility of cells of buccal epithelium under the influence of microwave electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The influence of microwave EMFs (/spl lambda/=1.6 cm) on the ENN index (electronegative nucleus, %) of human buccal epithelium cell nuclei in vitro was investigated. The density of the radiated power flow to the surface of the object was 700 /spl mu/W/cm/sup 2/, and the exposure time was 20 min. A normalizing effect of microwaves on the ENN index was shown. For high initial values of the index irradiation lowered it, and for low initial values the opposite occurred.

articleTitle: Deformation of a homogeneous field by fractal cylindrical conductor
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of the projection integration of a model of a cylindrical conductor, in order to establish the fractal geometry of the surface of actual conductors, is presented. The /spl alpha/-characteristic component of an electric field is obtained. That has allowed us to define the strain of a homogeneous field by a cylindrical conductor with a fractal surface in the near zone.

articleTitle: Universal mobile communication system of the new generation-UMTS2000
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Existing radio standards are based on multiple access. These standards have a number of limitations. It is important to take into account some factors: interactive service provision; spectrum planning; cost; and market penetration. The possibilities for introducing UMTS/IMT-2000 services during network development is discussed.

articleTitle: Infotelecommunication services: classification, imaging forms and models
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Problem of choice in a communication branch consists of the following: at every step one must choose the best strategy of net development, accounting fullness, access possibility, quality and economy of infotelecommunication service operations. The main tasks of the conceptual choice, such as formalizing, classification and modeling of infotelecommunication services, are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of videopulse scattering by multilayer structures of ground type
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of numerical modeling processes of nonsinusoidal electromagnetic waves scattering by layered dielectric structures of ground type are described. The results of data processing after the inverse-conjugate filtration method are addressed.

articleTitle: Low noise microwave FETs
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of design and fabrication of GaAs FETs are presented. These FETs can serve as active elements for hybrid ICs with operating frequencies of 4 and 12 GHz. By cooling the FETs down to 80 K one can substantially improve their microwave parameters.

articleTitle: Methods for evaluation of petrol quality
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)

articleTitle: Piezo-tuned microwave filters based on dielectric resonators
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The functional possibilities of microwave filters based on dielectric resonators (DR) are extended by the control of their central frequency (f/sub 0/) and attenuation-frequency characteristic (AFC). With this purpose, frequency tunable high Q-factor DRs were used. Commonly accepted designs of DR-filters are unsuitable for such a control owing to the distortion of the AFC during controlling. Hence a new design of DR-based fitters is proposed, in which frequency is controlled with the undistorted shape of AFC. Based on these concepts, simple bandpass and bandstop frequency tuned filters were realized.

articleTitle: Automation microwave wave-conducting structure design
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The application package SEARCH-P is described which is intended for the analysis and synthesis of waveguiding structures for the modelling and realisation of microwave devices.

articleTitle: Choice models for technical means of infotelecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: As a rule, we have operating and nonconnecting telecommunication nets. Concepts of their design are constantly changing; necessity of modernizing or changing their channel and device technical means spring up. Methods of choice for versions of network devices on the basis of system models, are considered. It allows one to choose technical means of the devices dependent on the load of each device.

articleTitle: Physics-topological design of GaAs field-effect transistors with a Schottky barrier
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: In this paper the results of physics-topological design of GaAs field-effect transistors with a Schottky barrier (MESFET) are presented. A linear process and physics-based MESFET model were used for the design. A distinctive feature of the model is that the output parameters of the designed device can be forecast before its manufacture and measurement of the microwave parameters. The questions concerning the influence of the fundamental technological factors are surveyed: channel doping density and electron mobilities; the geometrical dimensions of the transistor; gate lengths, fingers width and quantity. The parameters of the MESFET equivalent circuit and maximum available gain of the transistor in a frequency band are deduced. The good coincidence of calculated and measured parameters is shown.

articleTitle: Wide-band commutator
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: This work describes the design of a wide-band 4/spl times/4 matrix for 2-8 GHz band, which is built on a perpendicular microstrip lines connection basis. The matrix is designed for signal distribution on a transmitting multipath array. It provides independent transmission of 4 in-signals into 4 out-signals with a gain of /spl plusmn/3 dB and isolation of more than 35 dB. Input coaxial RF-connectors are connected to switches, which are vertically mounted on a metallic base. Power combiners are based on the "travelling wave" type. The use of three-sectional chains of power combining in the wide-bandwidth allows us to reduce the influence of closed channels reflection on open channel gain. Control voltages are inserted through RL circuits into the output of the combiners. Compensating two-stages amplifiers are built with dissipative matching circuits and 300 micron gate transistors. Matrix size :130/spl times/70/spl times/20 mm.

articleTitle: Synthesis of "hairpin" microstrip microwave filters with electromagnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The new method of synthesis of microstrip "hairpin" filters with allowance for dissipative losses has been presented. The method of calculation has envisaged the topology of a four-circuit filter for the synthesis, and its amplitude-frequency and phase-frequency responses are given.

articleTitle: Experimental test of optimum sectional waveguide tapers for quasi-optical circuits
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The optimum sectional waveguide taper (OSWT) for the broadband coupling of quasi-optical circular-section waveguides of the class "hollow dielectric waveguide" has been realized in a four-sectional form and tested. Obtained over the broad band 2.5-8 mm, the measurement results validate the formulae on which the suggested OSWT design is based. Compared to the ordinary linear taper, the OSWT essentially reduces the transition region but retains the broadband property and ease of manufacture of the linear taper.

articleTitle: Automatic design of nonlinear microwave devices
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The task and common algorithm for nonlinear microwave device design was overseen with the application of CAD. An algorithm is illustrated with examples of different design tasks for multiplier and mixer solving.

articleTitle: Hyperhigh-frequency laser with pumping of supersonic frequency current
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A hyperhigh-frequency HCN discharge laser for biomedical investigations in clinical conditions is described. This laser is pumped by alternating current supersonic frequency. The gas discharge excitation is realised with the original electrodes placed outside the quasioptical resonator of waveguide type. The laser radiation parameters at 337 mm are presented.

articleTitle: Methods of construction of automated measuring complex for evaluation of statistical performances of radiosystems
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of the review and analysis of the construction methods for a measuring complex based on a PC for an evaluation of statistical performances of radio systems are given.

articleTitle: Some possibilities of quantum integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of modeling of some elementary integrated circuits based on relaxation quantum transistors are presented. It is shown that at expected characteristics of transistors the circuits may be used at frequencies of 10-40 THz.

articleTitle: The self-controlled MM-band limiter of power
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The construction of the broadband microwave limiter of power intended for the protection of input circuits of microwave-receivers is considered. The experimental results obtained using a proposed construction are summarised.

articleTitle: Calculation of the harmonic filter on rectangle dielectric resonators in microstrip-line
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The technique and results of the calculation of the main characteristics of a microstrip line with a rectangular dielectric resonator (RDR) placed on it are presented. On the basis of the obtained algorithm using a single-mode-approximation, a band-rejection filter of second and third harmonics is designed.

articleTitle: Unit for retransmission of satellite radio navigation signals
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The method and device for retransmission of signals of satellite radio navigation systems (SRNS) for remote monitoring of vehicle location are presented. A feature of this device is modulation of the pilot signal by a pseudo random code with identical parameters to the informational one, transmitted from the satellites. It allows us to provide the power balance of the retransmitted informational signal and a pilot signal. Also the use of the reserve SRNS informational channel for the transfer of the pilot signal results in a reduction of the frequency band.

articleTitle: The national standard base of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of realization of the program for creation of the Ukrainian standard base are presented. The particular attention is paid to the standard base in the field of electrical and magnetic measurements.

articleTitle: High sensitivity EPR analyser with extended tuning range of microwave power
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The block diagram of high sensitivity EPR spectrometer is presented. A feature of the device is the automatic adjustment of coupling coefficient of measurement resonator with microwave circuit. This provides the operation of spectrometer in a wide range of microwave power and makes it easier working with the device.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillator with the shielded dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A Gunn oscillator with partially shielded hemidisk quasioptical resonator is investigated experimentally in this paper. The investigations of the generation characteristics of oscillations by the semiconductor diode in this resonator are carried out for the different radial co-ordinates of the oscillator active element. The advantages of the investigated oscillator in comparison with the oscillator with an open dielectric resonator are shown.
