articleTitle: Technology of waveguide-slot devices production and its influence on devices' parameters
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Coupling slots are used for construction of microwave transformers for the measuring devices of waveguide transmission line parameters, small directional couplers, travelling-wave resonators, directional filters, couplers of circular polarization and other devices. The coupling slot, cut through in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide, must excite the electromagnetic waves independently from the frequency phase displacement between them. In a wide frequency band quasi-fixed phase displacement provides the selection of optimum geometrical slots parameters: distance between slots centers, transversal co-ordinate centers, inclination corner. However, at slotting the received parameters can differ sufficiently from the calculated ones. Consequently phase displacement will change and the parameters of microwave devices will deteriorate. A means which defines the permissible deviations of these parameters but does not change essentially the phase displacement nor degrade the devices parameters, is necessary. The modern technology of microwave device production make it possible to achieve such significant manufacturing tolerances.

articleTitle: Polymer electronic devices with field control
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Electrophysical parameters of the structures created by ion implantation of polyamide-6 films are investigated. Possibility of switch device formation on the polymer base is shown. Perspectives of switch creation using planar technology are estimated.

articleTitle: Monitoring system of ecologically unsafe objects based on microwave gauges
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Technical characteristics of a system for ecologically unsafe objects are given. Measured parameters are fluid level, displacement, temperature and pressure. The system includes up to 64 precise 8-mm gauges with quasi-continuous emission. Gauges are linked to a central block through RS-485 interface. For large distances, radio-channel or dial-up lines can be used for communications.

articleTitle: Experimental characteristics of GaAs-harmonic generators of mm-band
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Experimental samples of Gunn-diodes had m-n/sup +/-n-n/sup +/-m pattern and were made on the base of epitaxial films of n-GaAs, on low-impedance n/sup +/-substrate with given impurity concentration. The Gunn-diodes with given lengths of active n-area were made. Length of n-area was selected from an operation condition of the diode in transient-time mode on a base frequency. The Gunn-diodes, designed and manufactured in such a way, had a packageless design.

articleTitle: Electric strength of the magnetron-pulse modulator tube system
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of the investigation of electric strength of the magnetron-pulse modulator tube system are presented. The influence of the internal electrical discharges an the life of the devices was analyzed.

articleTitle: HF-dielectric permeability of the polyoxybutyrate polymer
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The dielectric constants of a polymer polyoxybutyrate of biological origin are investigated as a function of temperature and frequency of electromagnetic field. An use for polyoxybutyrate as a protective covering of microwave circuit plates is shown.

articleTitle: Coaxial helical antenna with improved isolation
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Two cylindric helical antennas (CHA) being exited in an axial radiation mode at different frequencies have different helix diameters, and they can be placed in a coaxial manner one inside the other. To obtain electrical characteristics of a coaxial helical antenna (COHA) similar to the characteristics of the single CHA in the required frequency band, it is necessary in the design to ensure an improvement in the isolation between the helices. In this work the band properties of a COHA and ways to improve the isolation between helices are considered.

articleTitle: Measurement of dielectric permittivity of liquids with high losses at microwave frequencies
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of analysis of microwave dielectric permittivity measuring circuit on the basis of inserted waveguide cell losses determination are presented. The measuring circuit can be used for researches of viscous high-loss liquids including suspensions with dispersed particles.

articleTitle: Two-element waveguide passing power sensor based on absorbing wall principle
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of minimization in a strip of frequencies of the factor of transformation of the primary converter of falling or penetrating power are given on the basis of an absorbing wall with sensitive unequal elements of the marginal sizes located on a wide wall of the rectangular waveguide. As a criterion of optimality we accept the equality of values of losses capacity (on two rectangular sites of a wide wall waveguide) on boundary frequencies of a working strip of frequencies.

articleTitle: 3D mathematical model of nontraditional magnetron
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The 3-D mathematical model of the nontraditional magnetron generator is considered. The simulation is by a particle-in-cell method (PIC-method) in quasi-periodic single-mode and nonrelativistic approximations. The results of computer modelling of nonlinear interaction processes are represented.

articleTitle: Crossed-field system analysis
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Crossed-field systems are widely used in industrial, scientific and medical applications. However there are some problems in this system; for example, large oscillation instability. Correction of this problem is provided by the detailed observation of interaction oscillation. This report discusses such crossed-field systems as magnetron diodes. The magnetron diode is a simple crossed-field system but it is a complex dynamical system. In this report we propose to investigate the magnetron diode behavior by phase space method and estimated oscillation by Bogolubov-Mitropolsky method.

articleTitle: MDS-structure with carbon diamond-like film (CDLF)
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: CDLF of carbon obtained by an ionic-radial method with the following parameters was used: thickness 6-40 nm; pattern amorphous with crystallites Sp/sup 3/ of a phase with size /spl Gt/1 nm; structure has 97% carbon and 3% hydrogen; a factor of an interception 2.0-2.2 on /spl lambda/=0.632 /spl mu/m; resistivity /spl rho/=10/sup 11/-10/sup 13/ /spl Omega//spl middot/cm; electrical field of a breakdown 5/spl middot/10/sup 9/ V/m. The analysis of the above-stated parameters indicates high enough dielectric properties of received films. For manufacturing of MDS-structure GaAs of n-type with an electron concentration 10/sup 14/-10/sup 16/ m/sup -3/, thickness /spl Gt/300 /spl mu/m was used. After clearing of the surface on a lamina GaAs a film of carbon was deposited. Thickness of the film is 6-40 nm. The subsequent technological operations reshaped MDS structure control. A welding rod of diameter from 0.2 up to 1 mm was made by a series spraying of chromium, copper and indium. The indium was sprayed on the back part of GaAs substrate. It served as the second contact of MDS-structure. At such a thickness of dielectric the MDS-structure represents an MDS-capacitor. The current-voltage characteristic looked like the usual characteristic of the metal-semiconductor contact. The currents were 100-150 /spl mu/A at voltage drop 1-3 V. Sometimes patterns had a linear current-voltage characteristic. We think this is connected with the large number of structural defects and disturbance in the field of an interphase boundary arising during a deposition of a film.

articleTitle: The scattering fields control by antenna arrays of reflective type
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Microstrip reflective antenna arrays (RAA) are considered. A possible RAA application area is discussed and it is shown that RAAs are a very attractive type for smart cover design at microwave frequencies. Computer simulation is performed using a mathematical model based on periodic structure theory and integral equation system solution. The numerical results presented prove the possibility of RAA application as smart cover microwave modules.

articleTitle: Hybrid microwave converters with controlled discontinuities
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The use of hybrid microwaves converters with controlled discontinuities for construction of small-sized meters of parameters of microwave tracts, is analyzed. The results of theoretical and experimental researches of hybrid microwave converters are given.

articleTitle: The analysis of physical factors defining exactitude of measurement of projectile movement parameters on the initial stage of a shot
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The analysis of singularities of radar signals (RS) obtained when measuring projectile movement parameters (PMP) on the initial stage of a shot is carried out. The model permitting one to explain the reasons for RS distortion is offered.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic model of an elliptical loop antenna
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: An appreciable increase in the broadcasting station network and a deterioration of the electromagnetic situation have resulted in the necessity to update the receiving antennas owing to the high requirements for broadband, directionality and various operational and consumer needs. Nowadays various constructions of folded-dipole antennas and circular antennas have been investigated in depth and used widely. However, the perspective of closed antenna improvement consists of a compromise between advantages and shortcoming of the boundary geometric version. This can be achieved by optimization of loop antenna shapes. In the present work, the approximate physico-mathematical model of an elliptical loop antenna with shunts is presented. This model is based on decomposition of the antenna current on equivalent in-phase and out-of-phase components. The analytical associations necessary for an evaluation of the radiation field and input impedance of the antenna were obtained.

articleTitle: Numerical research of noise characteristics of electronic bunch in electrovacuum devices
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A principal possibility of realization of noise diagnostics of quality of constructive details of electrovacuum devices with the use of numerical dynamic models is considered.

articleTitle: Excitation of the high-Q-factor whispering gallery modes in the hemispherical dielectric resonator with the cylinder shield
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: A hollow metal cylinder with a semicircle in the base is used as the shield of a hemispherical dielectric resonator with whispering gallery (WG) modes. It is shown that the spectrum of the WG modes of this resonator is clearer than the spectrum of a similar resonator with a hemispherical shield. It is determined that the high-Q-factor WG modes are excited in the proposed resonator by the coupling slot on the mirror. Their fields are localized in the dielectric. The frequency dependence of the Q-factor value is measured. A good conformity of this experimental dependence with the analytic dependence is obtained in this paper.

articleTitle: H/sub m0/ resonant wave scattering on a ferro-dielectric layer in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The rigid solution of the wave scattering problem on a transversely magnetized ferro-dielectric layer in a rectangular waveguide has been obtained. The convergence of the numerical computation of the dissipation matrix elements depending on the values of the magnetic field has been studied. In case of the absence of a dielectric a similar solution has been obtained and its accuracy has been determined.

articleTitle: Fabrication of nanodimensional objects by atomic-force lithography methods
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: An atomic-force lithography method yielding individual elements of <100 nm size has been developed. It involves deformation of the masking layer with an atomic-force microscope probe, followed by plasma-chemical etching and deposition of metal contacts through the mask.

articleTitle: Large-orbit gyrotrons and peniotrons with traveling waves
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The research of optimum states of the large-orbit gyrotrons and peniotrons with traveling wave on high harmonics of the cyclotron frequency is presented.

articleTitle: Singularities of measurement of antenna parameters in anechoic chambers
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of measurements of some parameters of the receiving and transmitting antennas which have been carried out in an anechoic chamber, are represented. Thus the influence of overall dimensions and frequency properties of this chamber on measured performances of antennas was taken into account.

articleTitle: Investigation of near field of patch antenna
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The paper deals with a rectangular microstrip patch antenna radiator. Experimental results of an investigation of near-field space distribution for this radiator in the 10 GHz band are presented. The peculiarities of the electric field component due to the frequency variations are described. It is shown that the vibrating string can be used as a test perturbation body for near-field measurements of a microwave radiator.

articleTitle: The diffractional radiation generator packaged with a local magnetostatic inhomogeneity
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Reports on the creation of the first sample of DRG packaged with magnetic inhomogeneity (DRG-MI) for the fundamental research in experimental physics at millimeter wave-band (45-73 GHz).

articleTitle: Highly effective irregular coupled-cavity TWT
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Offers strategies to optimize coupled-cavity TWTs. Indicates the results of of optimization of parameters of irregular TWTs with calculated efficiency of more than 50%. The band performances of optimized variants of TWT are analysed.

articleTitle: Diffraction screens
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: Diffraction screens are one of the methods which are applied to decrease the level of electromagnetic radiation. The screens should satisfy the whole complex of the radio engineering, mechanical, technological and operational requirements. The absence of universal radio-screen materials results in necessity of their careful selection for each specific case. The authors present a review of results of a study of the protective characteristics of all-metal, mesh and punched screens based on metal films.

articleTitle: Features of creation of a national satellite network of distribution of the programs of telebroadcasting
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The results of the technical designing of a satellite distribution network of data support, created in Ukraine, are presented. Its technical feasibility and some features of its implementation are discussed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of measurement errors for radiation field polarization characteristics by using the method of three antennas
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The analysis of measurement errors for antenna polarisation characteristics (PC) is presented on the basis of the method of three antennas (MTA). Analytical expressions for calculation of radiation field (RF) components are in different polarization basic sets.

articleTitle: Definition of direction and frequency of radio source for the signal/noise ratio of -3 db
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The method of digital definition of a direction onto the radio source (RS) is described for the signal/noise ratio of minus 3 dB. The block diagram of the device and examples are given.

articleTitle: The waveguide effects in hybrid structures
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The investigation results of a milimeter-wave band electrodynamic structure which consists of periodical substructures are represented. The principle characteristic of such structures is the possibility of leaky waves and surface wave processes excitation.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic systems based on the dominating Wood's anomalies in diffractional electronics
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: The model of the electrodynamic system based on the dominating Wood's anomalies was analysed. The analytical method for description of Wood's anomalies for diffractional electronics was developed, taking into consideration the finite complex conductivity of diffracted structure, electrodynamic system spatial anisotropy, surface electromagnetic waves secondary rescattering, including resonant processes in the Wood's anomalies areas.

articleTitle: Wideband output system of a two-gun klystron
publicationTitle: 1999 9th International Crimean Microwave Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.99EX363)
abstract: An equivalent circuit of the output system of a two-gun klystron amplifier is offered and some methods of its optimum tuning are considered. A circuit with two relatively independent current sources in each gun is described.
